### gemini-code-assist[bot] · 2026-09-18 · COMMENTED

## Code Review

This pull request optimizes test dataset loading by limiting dataset splits to smaller subsets, specifically updating `test_moe_context.py` and dynamically slicing the dataset in `test_quantization.py` based on `num_eval`. The reviewer notes that because some samples may be skipped during perplexity evaluation, loading exactly `num_eval` samples could lead to evaluating fewer samples than expected or a `ZeroDivisionError`. They suggest loading a larger buffer of samples (e.g., `num_eval * 2`) and restoring the loop-break condition to safely cap the evaluation.
